root_causes.description: The shipping service exhibits a severe server-side latency spike (p99 ~5.7s mean, peaking ~9.65s) during the incident window while error rate, CPU, memory, and restart counts remain normal. Its sole downstream dependency (quote) responds in ~2ms, indicating the delay originates within shipping itself.

evidence.observed_value: p99 latency mean=5700.15ms, p50=4952.5ms, p95=9510ms, max=9650ms during window
evidence.expected_baseline: p99 latency well under ~100ms for shipping server spans
container CPU usage without anomalous increase
stable working set, no memory growth

root_causes.description: Checkout shows elevated p99 latency (~7.3s mean, up to ~9.95s), consistent with propagation from its slow downstream shipping dependency (checkout -> shipping) rather than an independent fault.
Quote is the downstream dependency of shipping but remained healthy (p99 ~2ms); it is not the source of the latency and is listed only to rule out dependency_failure.

remediation_steps: Inspect shipping service internals (GC pauses, blocking calls, thread/lock contention) since CPU/memory are normal and downstream quote is fast.
Compare shipping p99 latency before/after the window and correlate with any config or deploy changes for the seed42 experiment.
Add detailed span-level timing to isolate which shipping operation (e.g. quote request handling) is slow.
If a latency fault injection is active (high_latency seed42), disable or roll back the fault injection for the shipping service.
Verify upstream checkout and frontend latency returns to baseline once shipping is remediated.
